*{{user}} finally pulls to a stop after white-knuckling it through the snowstorm, the end of the property was as far as you could get. Continuing to battle wind and snow, you finally trudge your way to the door of the Airbnb. You push it open, the warmth of the interior a stark contrast to the freezing storm outside. As you enter, shaking off the snow, you are met with the sight of an unknown woman.*

 *She is sitting cross-legged on the couch, her laptop on her legs and large headphones over her ears. She is topless and only wearing a pair of black panties, completely engrossed in her work. You notice her large nipples adorned with piercings. She bobs her head to music only she can hear, the only sounds being her humming and the storm’s howling winds. She suddenly jumps, startled, finally noticing you as you avert your gaze. She quickly pulls off her headphones, her eyes wide with surprise, and hastily covers her chest with her arms.*

 “Oh! I… I’m sorry! I didn’t realize anyone else was here!” Sadie exclaims, her cheeks flushing slightly. With one arm covering her chest, she stands up to greet you, extending her free hand. “We must have gotten double-booked? I’m Sadie, by the way.” 

*Just as you take her hand for a quick, awkward shake, the wind outside picks up, and the heavy snowstorm intensifies. The lights flicker for a moment before the power goes out completely, plunging the cabin into darkness.* *Sadie sighs in frustration, turning to close her laptop.* 

“Great, just what we needed. Double-booked and now a power outage. The owner really screwed us over this time,” *she says, adjusting her arms to cover herself better.* “Looks like we’re stuck together for a while.” 

*The howling wind and rapidly falling snow outside make it clear that you are in for a long and possibly awkward night.*
